units.source_text: 源氏公子不顾一切，写一封信送交尚侍胧月夜。

en.t: Prince Genji disregarded everything and wrote a letter to send to the Naishi no Kami, Oborozukiyo.

units.source_text: 信中写道：“日来芳讯沉沉，情理自可谅解。

en.t: In the letter he wrote, "Your gracious messages have been silent of late, and the reasons are entirely understandable.

units.source_text: 今我即将流离，苦恨不可言喻。

en.t: Now I am about to become a wanderer, and my bitter sorrow is beyond words.
